documents.statement: Our student club usually teaches spreadsheet and research skills in classrooms.
The cabinet prefers an afternoon workshop of about 25 students.
For conferences we invite a guest speaker and collect their biography privately.
The academic club archives a short summary after each workshop.
Our club hosts small film discussions and student art displays.
We normally reserve a classroom for discussion screenings.
Exhibition volunteers prepare printed posters for campus displays.
The cultural club keeps an inventory of display boards for reuse.
Our student club stages concerts and plays with student performers.
The cabinet prefers an auditorium for performances.
Volunteers help with seating before performances.
The social club keeps an internal list of reusable stage props.
